name: dUpLicity ~Uso no Saki ni Aru Mono~
source:
Yukina Kudou is a third-year high school student with a secret.
Behind her daily sickly school girl act, she has important job to do.
One day, she receives a warning that she's doing her job terribly, 
and if there is no improvement upon her graduation, she will be fired.
She has only six months. What is this secret position she holds? What is its true goal?

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/duplicity/eindex.html/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
工藤雪奈是一名高三学生，身上藏着一个秘密。
她每天在学校装成体弱多病的少女，背地里却肩负着一项重要工作。
某天，雪奈收到警告：她的工作表现糟糕透顶，如果毕业时还没有改善，就会遭到解雇。
她只剩6个月时间。那份秘密职务究竟是什么？真正目的又是什么？

[译自 [url=http://www.roseverte.net/duplicity/eindex.html/]官方网站[/url]]
